hints.title: Boundary Digits
hints.text: Extract the leading digit of the first number and the trailing digit of the second number.

hints.title: Coprime Check
hints.text: Check if the greatest common divisor of the two digits equals one.

hints.title: Pair Iteration
hints.text: Count all index pairs (i, j) with i strictly less than j satisfying the coprime condition.

hints.title: Pairwise Coprime Count

complexity.notes: Quadratic iteration across array elements with O(1) gcd check.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Small n bounds make direct pair checking fast and simple.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Extracts first and last digits cleanly and tests coprime condition.
